name: Sreerang P
bio: I'm Sreerang P, an Electrical & Computer Engineering student at TKM College of Engineering (KTU 2024 Scheme, expected graduation 2029) and a BS Data Science & Applications student at IIT Madras. I build software, developer tools, and data-driven products, and I'm especially interested in AI, machine learning, and solving practical problems through code. I learn by shipping projects, testing ideas, and iterating in the open.

projects.title: Modulr
